name: Parkour Civilization [VILLAIN UPDATE]
desc:
! THIS GAME IS CURRENTLY IN ALPHA, EVERYTHING IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE !

Welcome to Parkour Civilization! In this game you start as a noob and you need to parkour in order to get better and rank up! You can become a champion and rule over parkour civilization! Or you can become a Villain and take over parkour civilization... Choice is yours!

[CONTROLS]:
Shift - run (You can run only as a pro+)

[TIPS]:
Use 1st face instead of shift lock on PC to make some jumps easier!
You doesn't lose your role upon dying as Legend and above!

[CHANGELOG]:
Way to get villain!
QoL changes
Small fixes

[IN-PROGRESS]:
Way to get God
Champion obtainment overhaul
Fun things to do with ranks

[NOTE]:
Roles legend+ WILL be hard to get so dont expect it to be easy. (Hopefully next update wont take a decade to make :< )
HINT: find NPC at fighters layer to get villain


Heavy inspired by Evbo's parkour civilization and "Parkour Civilization" game on roblox by Alyth Studios (Ipichlides)
